crossRefs.note: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

translations.web: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
translations.bsb: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
translations.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
translations.asv: and that which thou sowest, thou sowest not the body that shall be, but a bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other kind;
